# i2 Notebook Web SDK

> TypeScript SDK (`@i2analyze/notebook-sdk`) for building plug-ins for the i2 Analyst's Notebook web client. Plug-ins add commands, tool views, and read/change chart data.

IMPORTANT: create new plug-ins with `npm create @i2analyze/notebook-plugin` (the create-notebook-plugin tool) — do not hand-roll a project or copy the basic-plugin sample as boilerplate. See the agent guide below.

## Start here
- [Agent guide (AGENTS.md)](https://i2group.github.io/notebook-sdk/AGENTS.md): rules, patterns, and footguns for writing plug-ins.
- [Full docs bundle (llms-full.txt)](https://i2group.github.io/notebook-sdk/llms-full.txt): the entire guide + API rollup in one file.
- [Create a plug-in (tutorial)](https://i2group.github.io/notebook-sdk/guide/tutorials/create-notebook-plugin.html): the recommended scaffold path.
- [API reference](https://i2group.github.io/notebook-sdk/api/): full generated API docs.
- [Plug-in manifest schema](https://i2group.github.io/notebook-sdk/schemas/plugin-manifest.json)
